findings.evidence: `Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Basis.lean:55) and `EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr` (Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean:813) both exist; `WithLp` is a structure (Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/WithLp.lean:50), so the defeq runs through `ofLp` and structure eta.
findings.fix: Make the step explicit: `congr 1; ext i j; simp [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr]`.
findings.issue: `congr 1` silently closes `((basisFun (Fin n) ℝ).toBasis.toMatrix v).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => v j i).det` by definitional equality through `WithLp.ofLp` and `Basis.repr`; nothing in the proof names why the two matrices are the same.

findings.evidence: Line 507-510; every other equivalence identity in the file (`transverseBoost_symm`, line 424) is proved via `ext1` plus rewriting rather than `rfl`.
findings.fix: Prove it through the API: `by ext1 p; rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]; apply ext_lightFront <;> simp` (the transverse component then closes by `LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply`).
findings.issue: `transverseIsometry_symm : (transverseIsometry R).symm = transverseIsometry R.symm := (rfl)` proves an equality of bundled `LinearEquiv`s by `rfl`, which depends on `R.symm.symm` reducing to `R` and on the `invFun`/proof fields matching definitionally — not on any stated fact.

findings.evidence: Four copies of `Real.mul_self_sqrt zero_le_two` at lines 230, 238, 258, 287; Mathlib has no `Real.sqrt_two_mul_self` (grep over ./mathlib finds only `Real.mul_self_sqrt`, Analysis/Real/Sqrt.lean:149).
findings.fix: Factor the √2 round-trip into one private lemma (e.g. `(x / √2 + y / √2) / √2 = (x + y) / 2`, proved once from `Real.mul_self_sqrt zero_le_two`) and derive the four sites by rewriting with it, so no proof depends on `field_simp`'s output shape.
findings.issue: The same `have : √2 * √2 = 2` plus `field_simp; linear_combination <hand-tuned coefficient> * this` is repeated four times (lines 230-233, 238-241, 258/262-263 and 267-269, 287/291-293); the coefficients `(-a)`, `(-b)`, `(-p (Sum.inl 0))`, `(p⁰q⁰ - p³q³)` are valid only for the exact normal form `field_simp` currently produces.

findings.evidence: `PiLp.inner_apply : ⟪x, y⟫ = ∑ i, ⟪x i, y i⟫` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean:104); `inner_eq_star_dotProduct` is stated in terms of `ofLp` (PiL2.lean:216).
findings.fix: Use `PiLp.inner_apply` with `Fin.sum_univ_two` to get `⟪p_T, q_T⟫ = p_T 0 * q_T 0 + p_T 1 * q_T 1` before any field clearing, instead of `inner_eq_star_dotProduct` + `dotProduct` + `star_trivial`.
findings.issue: `minkowskiProduct_eq_lightFront` routes the transverse inner product through `EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct` and then unfolds the definition `dotProduct` in a `simp only`, and has to re-apply `transversePart_apply_zero/one` *after* `field_simp` (line 292) because `field_simp` disturbs the goal — an unfolding-heavy, order-sensitive script.

findings.evidence: `module` and `match_scalars` are available (mathlib/Mathlib/Tactic/Module.lean:763 and :734); both goals are identities in a module over ℝ with no hypotheses beyond `hP`.
findings.fix: Replace the scalar bookkeeping by `module` (or `match_scalars <;> field_simp`) after the one domain-specific rewrite, e.g. `rw [transversePart_transverseBoost, relativeTransverse_def, div_eq_mul_inv]; module`.
findings.issue: Brittle named-lemma rewrite chains for pure scalar-action normalisation: lines 444/446 (`← smul_neg, ← h', smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀, one_smul`) and line 552-553 (`transversePart_transverseBoost, relativeTransverse_def, smul_neg, smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv, sub_eq_add_neg`), each closing by the implicit `rfl` of the last `rw`.

summary: Two proofs close non-trivial goals by undocumented definitional equality (`congr 1` on a basis matrix, `rfl` on an equality of `LinearEquiv`s), and the √2 arithmetic is a four-times-repeated `field_simp` plus hand-tuned `linear_combination` whose coefficients are pinned to `field_simp`'s normal form. Fixable with named lemmas and existing automation.
